metadata.extraction_method: Cross-validated from 3 sources: Gemini CLI standardized markdown, Original OCR markdown, and existing batch JSON
cross_validation_notes: Tests selected cover major electrical, mechanical, and thermal tests.
Vibration/Shock/Crush are confirmed by both Gemini and Batch JSON to apply specifically to LER and VAP applications.
Mold Stress test requires max temp + 10C (min 70C) for 7h as noted in Gemini MD, and only applies to polymeric materials.
Single Cell Failure Test (Thermal Propagation) must show no fire outside enclosure and no explosion; internal fire is acceptable.
